title: 90-day trajectory commitment and confidence memo
creator: Ariana Chen
description:
Purpose: Produce a concise executive memo and 6-slide pack for the monthly strategy sync that summarizes our 90-day commitments across core platform initiatives, confidence levels, leading indicators, and escalation lanes. The memo will be the single source of truth for the exec readout and will feed the QBR packet if escalations are required.

Scope: Core initiatives in the platform roadmap (serving runtime improvements, Dedicated autoscaling controls, Private deployment maturity), top 3 cross-functional risks, ask list (headcount/time/capital), and decision points for leadership.

Deliverables:
- One-page memo summarizing 90-day commitments, confidence (High/Medium/Low) and risk mitigations.
- 6-slide executive pack: objectives, progress vs. OKRs, leading KPIs, risks & mitigations, asks & timeline, roll-forward options.
- Action tracker exported to shared board for follow-ups.

Audience: CEO, CTO, COO, Head of Engineering, Head of Sales.

Success criteria: Execs can scan the memo in <3 minutes and surface a single decision ask or sign-off. The deck should require no more than 10 minutes for the narrator to present.

Notes on approach and trade-offs: To keep the pack tight we are reducing initiative detail to only owner + primary metric + one tactical risk. This trades off visibility for breadth; engineering partners have agreed to use the detailed initiative dashboards for operational deep dives after the readout. If leadership wants more detail in the packet, we'll convert the appendix into an interactive Confluence board rather than expanding the main slides.
